279753423.description:
John P. Koehler
Blown Glass Cattail Sculpture
Art Glass, Agate, and Burl Wood
10" x 4" x 5"
Signed and dated 1992 on base
This intricate mixed media sculpture by artist John P. Koehler captures a stylized natural scene through a sophisticated combination of organic and artisanal materials. The work features hand-blown glass cattails accented with gold-tone luster and delicate clear glass reeds, all emerging from a base crafted from natural burl wood and polished agate geode slices. The composition reflects the studio glass movement of the late 20th century, emphasizing the contrast between the translucent, fragile nature of glass and the raw, earthy textures of stone and wood.
Features two distinct gold-flecked blown glass cattails and multiple slender glass reeds
Base constructed from a natural burl wood segment integrated with polished agate slices
Hand-signed and dated "7-1992" by the artist on the underside
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition. The glass elements are free of chips, cracks, or repairs. The burl wood and agate base are structurally sound with all components securely mounted. The signature on the underside remains clear and legible, and the four protective felt pads are present.
Thank you for all of your support!
